historyPolicy: Week 1 pregame state remains immutable in repository history. No candidate is added after its result is known.

coverage.eligibilityUniverse: complete 62-game canonical selected-week schedule; primary display filtered to governed football coverage/unified upset research
coverage.screenRule: Every FBS-v-FBS underdog with verified ML +300 or longer. FCS-v-FBS prices tracked separately when widely posted.

candidates.action: Use for research/screening only; re-verify an executable sportsbook price before any official decision.
candidates.note: Unified upset score is research-only with zero production impact. Non-current moneylines are visibly labeled and may not be used for execution.

qbStability.reason: Season QB EPA missing: capped at 1/4 despite matchup opportunity.

trenchResistance.reason: Team aggregate and defensive production with capped trench matchup adjustment; line-specific metrics pending.

explosivePath.reason: Observed offensive YPP and opposing pass defense; explosive-play rate unavailable.

compression.reason: Market total alone capped at 1.25/3; possession and drive evidence required for maximum.

havocVolatility.reason: Requires observed opponent-adjusted havoc and opponent turnover-worthy rate; no prose-only points.

coachingSituational.reason: No verified quantified situational advantage; neutral.

availability.reason: Verified net impact only; unknown is neutral.

productionModel.reason: Outright-win probability relative to implied benchmark, not ATS edge.

independentModel.reason: Win-probability corroboration with shared-input credit capped at 1/2.

scoreAudit.rule: 25-point directional rubric. Qualitative credit requires underdog-favorable evidence; model support is directional; no keyword-presence points.
